About me

Hey y'all! I'm Melany

I'm a country girl based in Milwaukee, and honestly, there's a little bit of everything that makes me who I am. One day you might find me riding horses, snowboarding, fishing, playing softball, or spending way too much time at the gym. I love being outdoors, trying new things, and keeping life interesting.

Most people know me as a model and former pageant girl, but there's so much more to me than just being in front of a camera. I'm also a singer, songwriter, and actor. I play guitar, write my own music, and have always loved expressing myself creatively in different ways.

Something else that's really close to my heart is being open about my mental health journey and advocating for dog rescue. I believe in being honest about the ups and downs of life, using my voice for things that matter, and giving a little extra love to the animals who need it most.

Whether I'm dressed up for a photoshoot, out enjoying the country life, making music, or just sharing little moments of my everyday life, I love creating content that feels like me. I'd love to share a little piece of my world with y'all.
